description:
Bridge ACTION lines in notes/logs into anchored TASK lines, and mutate those anchors. Source notes and logs ARE the store; there is no backend.

Usage with no subcommand: [] ingests every ACTION line found under notes/ and logs/, rewriting each in place to a TASK anchor with a fresh 8-char uuid. Flags: ["--dry-run"] show what would be ingested without writing; ["--quiet"] suppress per-action output. These two flags apply ONLY to the no-subcommand invocation.

Subcommands:
  add THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — buffer-append a structured ACTION (delegates to `buffer add-action`); does not create an anchor until flush+ingest
  done UUID — mark complete; rewrites source TASK to DONE and stamps end with today
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the anchor body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L; written as [#X] in the visible portion
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a depends entry
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a depends entry
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread THREAD] [--assignee PERSON] [--overdue] — list pending tasks, formatted
  next — top 5 pending tasks by (priority, due, entry)
  show UUID — detail view of one anchor

Flags:
  add: --due YYYY-MM-DD; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-char UUID prefix, repeatable for multiple deps.
  list: --priority one of H, M, L, filters to a single priority; --thread filters to tasks whose source note carries that thread, e.g. Processes/SGB; --assignee filters to a person; --overdue shows only tasks due before today.

Examples:
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--overdue", "--assignee", "Riaz Arbi"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]

Notes:
  UUID arguments accept a prefix; an ambiguous prefix exits 1 listing the candidates, as does a prefix matching nothing.
  Exit 1 also on: assignee that does not resolve to a people file, empty description, a task depending on itself.
  add writes to the buffer only. The ACTION becomes a real TASK anchor after `buffer flush` followed by a no-subcommand `tasks` run.
  Mutating subcommands rewrite the source note or log file in place.
  Do not hand-write TASK: lines; let ingest produce them.
